hero_fly_path_065.scope: Ordinary living Hero adult with locked Fly FIRST evolution. Full signed later axes retain nine unique corners, including opposite Swim training, without changing first type or biological age.
hero_fly_path_065.reference: Fresh independently operated Chao Island viewer with Fly first checkbox selected and Hero alignment. Fresh front/side and all nine mature forms front/side personally inspected before authoring; balanced mature back also inspected. Imported Hero Fly cuboids supply block construction vocabulary only.
hero_fly_path_065.approximation: Six closed head cuboids interpret paired white-root and two-color caps with auxiliary Power/Fly forks around the original square skull. Source smooth curves, wave zigzags, four thin Fly filaments, webbed feet and feathered fans are simplified. Balanced curls down/out, Run rises in a dramatic outward V and sweeps forward, Power adds upright prongs and small outer spurs, Fly grows long rearward/downward outer caps with upper filaments, opposite Swim flattens rearward, and mixed corners use separately authored silhouettes. Bilinear combinations and maturity pacing are authored approximations.
hero_fly_path_065.head_caps_policy: White/inherited root127; main caps and auxiliary spurs span proximal125/distal126 along actual local lengths including terminal faces. Unused auxiliary spurs remain positive closed solids buried inside roots and emerge smoothly. No head shell, forehead stripes or band geometry.
hero_fly_path_065.wing_policy: Three opaque closed cuboid rays per unchanged wing joint; fixed directions -12/+18/+48 degrees retain exact proximal hinge [0,.25,0]. Four longitudinal faces carry root124/distal123 pigments, and differing thicknesses avoid parallel coplanar overlap.
hero_fly_path_065.body_contact_policy: Top-only torso extension +.45 supports scoped .35 pixel walking head lift. Original joints and shoulder anchors remain exact; compact hands and feet grow moderately.
hero_fly_path_065.tail_policy: Original small tail geometry, native UVs and attachment retained unchanged.
hero_fly_path_065.marker_policy: Square four-bar Hero halo uses original emotion_dots/emotion_dot anchors and tilt; first bar retains original atlas artwork, three mesh-only children add the remaining bars.
hero_fly_path_065.provisional_rates: 960 current level-bar progress per opposing axis; independent adult maturity. Viewer settings do not establish original game levels or timing.
